Package org.geysermc.paletter.creative

Class CreativeEditor.GroupEditor

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.creative.CreativeEditor.GroupEditor
Enclosing class:
CreativeEditor
public final class CreativeEditor.GroupEditor extends Object
A live handle to a group. Stays valid when the group is moved, but not after it is removed.
